basic_info.description: 2BR/1BA condo in a well run, fully owner occupied 4-unit association with good reserves * Ideally laid out with an open kitchen/living/dining area with recessed lighting and direct access through sliding glass doors to a gorgeously landscaped exclusive use south garden and deck; perfect for indoor/outdoor entertaining * Updated chefs kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances including a 5-burner gas range * Updated bath with beautiful tile and soaking tub * 2 generous sized bedrooms with double closets * Newly refinished hardwood floors throughout, brand new carpet in the bedrooms  * Shared laundry in the garage (space for private laundry on the back deck - buyer to verify feasibility) * HOA has just completed a common hallway project with new interior paint and carpet  Large dedicated storage area * HOA Dues: $271/mo. (includes garbage, water, hot water, common area utilities/maintenance and contribution to reserves). Insurance is paid separately once a year by special assessment, currently $1360.03/unit * Fantastic Eureka Valley location with EZ access to Kite Hill, public transportation, tech shuttle stops and the shops and restaurants in the Castro and Noe Valley
